_comment: Lintel plugin hook auto-registration (ADR-0008). These register automatically when the plugin is installed — no manual settings.json merge. Closes the activation gap found in the 2026-06-12 fit audit: session-digest (ADR-0002) and memory-budget-warn (ADR-0006) had shipped but never fired. The safety hooks are included so a fresh install gets the core safety promise with zero setup; operators who previously merged them by hand into ~/.claude/settings.json should remove those manual entries to avoid double-fire (see docs/v4.x/migrations/_INDEX.md). Module warn-hooks stay opt-in via ~/.lintel/hooks symlinks. Shell-string form is used so Windows resolves bash via Claude Code's Git Bash discovery (exec-form "bash" requires bash.exe on the raw process PATH, which plain Windows lacks). Verify firing after plugin update: a session_digest record must appear in the repo's .claude/runtime/audit/hooks.jsonl — li-doctor checks this.
